name: Sanuki (Japan)
description: A pale green field charged at the centre with the Sanuki city emblem: a stylised letter S of curved strokes in navy and dark green.
history: Municipal flag of Sanuki, a city in Kagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 February 2003.

features.role: Sanuki city emblem — a stylised letter S of curved strokes in navy and dark green
